purpose: Character reference for the Aethelgard novel. Canon facts are separated from development material so invented database details do not silently overwrite the manuscript.

entries.name: Abel Thorne Valerius

dnd_profile.alignment_fit: Lawful Good drifting toward Neutral Good

entries.notes: Frost Resonance bloodline manifested at seven winters; used by House Valerius as an organic energy source; bloodright stripped and permanently banished by King Cassian; carries intense guilt over his family's crimes and refuses the throne. His magic now leaks unpredictably through his armor and he lacks disciplined control.

development_fields.sexual_orientation: Undeclared in manuscript; do not canonize without author decision

entries.name: Elara Sol-Voss
entries.notes: Street-hardened priestess and street-seer; carries a silver icon of Solis. Protective of Abel and increasingly terrified by threats to him. Her faith, practical survival instincts, and emotional loyalty frequently conflict.

development_fields.sexual_orientation: Undeclared in manuscript; do not canonize without author decision

entries.name: Thrum Iron-Marrow
entries.notes: Brick-red beard, heavy boots, forge wrench, mechanically minded, irreverent and curious. His humor often breaks tension without erasing danger.

development_fields.sexual_orientation: Undeclared in manuscript; do not canonize without author decision

entries.name: Kaelen Vane-Skar
entries.notes: Amber eyes, scales, massive frame, war-hammer and Silt Guard heritage. Fiercely protective. His kin were threatened by House Valerius policies, making Abel's choice to oppose the Spire personally significant.

development_fields.sexual_orientation: Undeclared in manuscript; do not canonize without author decision

entries.name: Vaelin Kael-Thar
entries.notes: Quiet, observant and tactically minded. His homeland and shadow faction were harmed by House Valerius. He tends to assess escape routes, patrol patterns and political danger before speaking.

development_fields.sexual_orientation: Undeclared in manuscript; do not canonize without author decision

entries.name: Lyra Emerald-Weft
entries.notes: Silver-white hair and emerald eyes. Learned High Elven from archival texts and ancient treaties but never used it as a spoken daily language. Her knowledge is literary and formal; when forced to speak it she is cautious, rusty and occasionally searches for the correct construction.

development_fields.sexual_orientation: Undeclared in manuscript; do not canonize without author decision
development_fields.combat_role: lore specialist / ritual scholar / battlefield utility

entries.name: Kikiasie
entries.notes: Usually called Kiki. Feline-Kin with pointed ears and expressive tail. Carries the black-scaled archival volume containing crucial coordinates. Uses playful sarcasm as both personality and pressure relief.

development_fields.sexual_orientation: Undeclared in manuscript; do not canonize without author decision

entries.name: Queen Althaea

dnd_profile.alignment_fit: Lawful Neutral with protective Good tendencies

entries.notes: Ancient elven sovereign wearing a hollowed dragon skull crown. Initially hostile to Abel and his companions, but recognizes that his Resonance is unusual and offers disciplined frost training after hearing his history.

development_fields.sexual_orientation: Undeclared in manuscript; do not canonize without author decision

entries.name: King Cassian Valerius
entries.notes: Abel's father. Stripped Abel of bloodright and permanently banished him. Rules through Spire authority and inherited imperial systems.

development_fields.sexual_orientation: Undeclared in manuscript; do not canonize without author decision

entries.name: Lady Vivienne Valerius
entries.notes: Abel's mother. Her lineage is recognized by the Kael-Vossen commander. Her personal history and political role remain partly unrevealed.

development_fields.sexual_orientation: Undeclared in manuscript; do not canonize without author decision

entries.name: King Aldus Valerius
entries.notes: Abel's grandfather. Queen Althaea attributes the first major colonial expansion, legal manipulation and displacement of neighboring civilizations to his reign.

development_fields.sexual_orientation: Undeclared in manuscript; do not canonize without author decision

entries.name: Malakor
entries.notes: Placed young Abel into alchemical laboratories after his Resonance manifested. Used Ley-Tech conduits and measurements to study the limits of Abel's body.

development_fields.sexual_orientation: Undeclared in manuscript; do not canonize without author decision

entries.name: Kael-Vossen Vanguard Commander

dnd_profile.alignment_fit: Lawful Neutral with severe anti-Valerius hostility

entries.notes: Native High Elven speaker. Deeply hates House Valerius and regards Abel's companions with suspicion for standing beside him. His restraint is tactical, not friendly. His personal name is intentionally pending canonical introduction.
